items.q: So we'd all go down to a fellow's place named Reuben on 130th Street between Seventh and Eighth.

ctx.x: could play up to a lot of them fellows, that's true. Knowledge (Unintelligible) used to have what they called the cutting contest.

So we'd all go down to a fellow's place named Reuben on 130th Street between Seventh and Eighth. Reuben had a place, he owned the building. So he built the thing downstairs for the fellows (but he served nothing) (but beer and wine) that old, funny kind of whiskey. But that's where Art Tatum (unintelligible) used to go.
What was the name of the place?
